summary.text: Jennifer Compeau is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 1B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Steve Gander.
A nonprofit professional who works as a Family Resource Coordinator, she was born and raised in East Grand Forks.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Compeau graduated from Fisher High School, earned an associate degree from Northland Community & Technical College in 2024, and has attended Minnesota State University, Mankato.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in East Grand Forks and that her experiences as a young mother, a person who rebuilt her life after significant challenges, and a nonprofit leader shaped her career helping families navigate public systems.

She said her work as a Family Resource Coordinator informs her interest in whole-person health care, including mental health and dental care, as well as education, family resources and community-based programs.

Compeau organized her campaign messages under the headings Action, Affordability and Accountability, and said she wants to expand access to affordable health care and housing and support strong public schools.
